exposure_before_freeze: Only workbook sheet names, text headers and angle columns exposed. Primary abstract and visibility summaries already read. No workbook measured cells read. Public model-development holdout, never blind.
primary_observation_map: mu_j(beta)=m_j[1+v_j C_k(beta-alpha_j-phi_j)], C_k=-E_k(cos(2 delta)), alpha_H=0deg alpha_D=45deg
nuisance: Separate constant brightness m_j>0, visibility 0<=v_j<=1 and axis offset phi_j in [-10,10] degrees for each H/D scan, estimated on calibration rows only. Common k>=0. No measured holdout retuning. These are not independently instrument-calibrated; conditional observation-map comparison only.
fit: Weighted least squares using released error columns; if errors/units not documented enough, report descriptive weighted residual scores only. No raw Poisson/binomial likelihood fabricated. k boundary scanned to at least20 and asymptotic saturation checked. Controls separately calibrate same nuisance class for k=0 and quantum cosine.
uncertainty: Cal-only local Hessian propagation and profile grid/parameter boundary checks conditional on independent Gaussian interpretation of source errors; label assumptions. Holdout common-nuisance prediction covariance retained. No significance until source definition, covariance and nuisance sufficiency reviewed.
holdout_exposure_rule: Read calibration values first, complete fits and freeze parameter/prediction packet before measured holdout extraction. Inspect paper figure only after this split; image exposure acknowledged if required for angle definition.
